summary: Test suite has a reasonable structure (clear separation between unit and e2e tests, good naming) but is fundamentally incomplete and would not run. Critical fixture files referenced by tests (junit-run1.xml, results-run3.json, fixtures-cases/caseB) are not provided, making unit tests unable to execute. Edge case coverage is sparse: no tests for malformed XML/JSON, empty inputs, special characters in test names, floating-point precision edge cases, or unusual-but-valid formatting. End-to-end testing via act is minimal (only 2 test cases) when comprehensive matrix scenarios are needed. Test assertions check for string presence rather than exact output format. The act test helper (run_case) is complex and relies on undocumented workflow output format (AGGREGATE_RESULT/FINAL_REPORT). No tests for error recovery, large datasets, or boundary conditions (negative durations, very large numbers). Tests would not reliably catch regressions in parsing logic, aggregation correctness, or markdown rendering edge cases.
